summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.setDate in its own file, with each spec step as a comment above its code. Steps run in spec order: this-check via date::this_time_value (step 2-3), then ops::to_number on the argument (step 4), NaN early return (step 5), LocalTime, MakeDate/MakeDay with YearFromTime/MonthFromTime/TimeWithinDay (step 7), TimeClip(UTC()) (step 8), store to [[DateValue]] (step 9), and return (step 10). Errors propagate with `?`. There are no test-specific branches and no made-up values. The only remaining not-implemented failures come from Date.prototype.setTime, which is outside this ticket. The one thing I could not check from the diff alone is that date::this_time_value really performs RequireInternalSlot and that the date:: helpers (make_day, make_date, utc, time_clip, local_time) match their spec algorithms, since those live in files not shown here.
notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing to fix in this diff. Before merging, confirm that crate::support::date::this_time_value throws a TypeError for non-Date receivers (RequireInternalSlot), and that make_day, make_date, utc, time_clip and local_time follow their spec algorithms (non-finite handling, ToIntegerOrInfinity, 8.64e15 bound). The 4 remaining failures need Date.prototype.setTime, which belongs to another ticket.
